title: FrameIt — Batch Image Branding Tool
description: FrameIt is a full-stack web app that lets users upload a batch of photos, apply a branded overlay once, and download all images as a ZIP file. Built for event photographers, social media managers, and anyone who needs to brand images at scale.

title: NaijaFix – Community Issue Reporting Platform
